product_updates.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
product_updates.content: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

product_updates.title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
product_updates.content: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.

product_updates.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
product_updates.content: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.
